name: Mag_OS — Vine Certificate — Database Evidence UI

parameters.query: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id,client_name,CASE WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE left(email,1)||'***'||substring(email from '@.*$') END AS email,certificate_name,amount,payment_status,certificate_code,certificate_link,created_at FROM vine_certificate_service.orders WHERE certificate_code='VINE-ORD1001-20260920-STNK'), v AS (SELECT certificate_code,owner_name,vine_name,photo_link,status,last_update FROM vine_certificate_service.vines WHERE certificate_code='VINE-ORD1001-20260920-STNK'), u AS (SELECT certificate_code,update_text,photo_link,date FROM vine_certificate_service.vine_updates WHERE certificate_code='VINE-ORD1001-20260920-STNK') SELECT '{{$json.table}}' AS requested_table,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM o)::text AS orders_json,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM v)::text AS vines_json,(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(u)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM u)::text AS updates_json;
